verdict.rationale: Segment's own Identity Resolution docs describe a real-time online/offline ID graph that uses cookie IDs, device IDs, emails, and custom external IDs to merge each customer's history into a single profile across web, mobile, server, and partner touch-points. Engage builds on it to merge cross-device event data into user- or account-level profiles. The evidence shows no documented or configurable resolution rules, such as merge priorities, identifier limits, or blocking rules, which are an explicit part of the story. missing for 10: documentation of configurable identity-resolution rules, explicit description of anonymous-to-known merge behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
